name: claudetto
description: Lists the claudetto plugin and its optional browser and docs plugins.

plugins.name: claudetto
plugins.description: Adds a lean output style, a main agent with a small agent roster, a permission gate for `Bash` commands, a status line command, and the `setup` skill. Adds the MiniSpec skills `propose`, `apply`, `verify`, and `archive`, a handoff file in place of the compaction summary, a `goal` check that blocks the stop until it passes, a ledger of edited files, and a cleanup at session start. Jev answers `AskUserQuestion` when a key is set.

plugins.name: claudetto-browser
plugins.description: Drives a real browser with `agent-browser` for pages that need JavaScript, a login, or clicks, and for checks of a UI change. `WebFetch` and `WebSearch` stay the tools for reading and search, because they cost fewer tokens.

plugins.name: claudetto-docs
plugins.description: Gets current library and API docs with the Context7 CLI `ctx7`. Works with no key.
